body:
Getting different results from the same curve would require the user to also set different eases/transitions explicitly, so my thought is that they'd be expecting it in that case (just as they'd get different results from using the same ease but a different transition, for example).

That being said, as I think about it more I can't think of any reasonable use cases for a curve on top of a transition/ease, which themselves are basically pre-defined curves as far as I understand. Given that as far as I can tell there aren't public getters for the transition or ease, having it ignore the transition/ease while not adding new values to their enums makes sense 🙂
